scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n firebase,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run emulators" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulators
scripts.test:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulators.json --project demo-carmitra --only auth,firestore "vitest run --project api --project rules"
